contradictions: Who merges this PR: the plan says the session merges on a go Mustafa gave 'before the PR existed'. The brief §2 says 'Mustafa merges it himself'. CLAUDE.md says a session merges only on a go 'given after the advisor approved that head', for the PR's current head. advisor.md says the same ('given after your APPROVE of its current head'). An advance go meets none of these. The plan should hand the merge to Mustafa.

Unit Forge versus the user's request: plan item 2 adapts 'Unit Forge's research runbook'. The user says Unit Forge is a separate, unfinished tool and the session should work on Shamble Frontlines. Build CHECKPOINTS.md from the brief's rules alone and keep Unit Forge references out of the repo. The earlier advisor verdict, condition 3, already asked for this.

'Reviewers are read-only' (CLAUDE.md line 114-115) versus plan item 7 and Risk 7, which give Write to art-director, perf-auditor, security-auditor, verifier and rust-reviewer, and to all six new agents writing docs/research/ and docs/adr/. The plan never edits that CLAUDE.md line. netcode-architect already has Write, so the line is already inaccurate. Reword it to something like 'reviewers never edit source; they write only their named docs folders and .checkpoints/ notes'.

NIGHT_SHIFT.md rule 4 ('If its state is unclear, restart that item cleanly') versus brief 2b rule 4 ('Never restart a task from scratch when a checkpoint exists') and the plan's new CLAUDE.md 'Never' line. The plan keeps the rule numbers and never says it removes the sentence.

Night-shift absolute rule 8 ('never delete branches, saves or data') versus checkpoint rule 5 ('delete .checkpoints/<task-slug>* in the last commit'). A night run that finishes an item would break one rule or the other. State that removing checkpoint files in a commit (history keeps them) is not 'deleting data'.

Night-shift absolute rule 8 ('never change .claude/ or CLAUDE.md') against night research and docs items: docs-keeper keeping REPO_MAP current, which lists .claude/ contents, is fine. But any night item that would touch agent files or CHECKPOINTS.md is barred, and NIGHT_SHIFT.md should say so for the 'focused agents per item type' flow.

CLAUDE.md hard constraints ('change ONLY through an accepted ADR signed off by Mustafa') versus plan item 1, which relabels the section '(the legacy game)' and has the phase 0 drafts 0001-0006 'take over ADR-001..003'. Scoping the constraints to legacy is itself a constraint change made without an accepted ADR. Leave the constraints as they are until the v2 ADRs are accepted, or escalate to Mustafa. The earlier advisor verdict, condition 4, agrees.

advisor.md PR review step 2 ('check ... that STATUS and ROADMAP were updated') and CLAUDE.md step 6 (docs-keeper updates ROADMAP and STATUS) versus the plan's deferral of STATUS and ROADMAP to a later docs pass. There is a precedent for this, but it must be listed in 'Decisions and deviations' or the PR Advisor will flag it.

'Review once, on the final diff' versus verifier.md's description 'Use after every implementation step and before any commit' and changeset step 5. Read loosely, this invites skipping verification. Spell out that verification still runs per step and only reviews run once.
New agents 'never source code' versus brief 2e 'When work runs in parallel, agents build in isolated copies' and CLAUDE.md step 3 (parallel implementation in isolated worktrees).
Brief 2b rule 2 ('Subagents write as they go ... never only in their own context') versus the plan keeping the advisor without Write and docs-keeper.md's 'edits only docs/'.

advisor.md escalation category 3 covers '.claude/', so checkpoint.mjs, settings.json and the agent files make this PR needs-mustafa. That fits the brief, but it is a further reason the session cannot class or merge this PR itself.

The autosave commits checkpoint.mjs makes with [skip ci] leave PR heads unchecked. That matches CLAUDE.md's merge rule only as long as the final head is never skip-ci and no autosave runs after 'ready'. The plan covers the first point but should guard the second (no watch or save once the PR is ready).
scope_creep: docs/V2_PHASE0_BRIEF.md (a byte-identical copy of the brief): not asked for. Justified, because later sessions, the night shift and the PR Advisor need the R1-R6 questions and the 'Don't' list. Keep it, as the plan proposes.

.claude/scripts/checkpoint.mjs plus its test and a background 'watch' mode with [skip ci] autosaves (about 120 lines): not asked for. The brief only requires commit and push after each step. It is partly justified, since agents that cannot commit lose notes otherwise, but it adds a script that pushes outside the Bash permission rules, which is a security-review item. The 'save' command is enough for the brief; 'watch' is optional and the riskier part. It should refuse to run once the PR is ready.

settings.json allows WebSearch and WebFetch without prompts: not asked for. It is justified for research topics and night research items. It widens prompt-injection exposure, falls under security rules (advisor category 3), and needs the security-auditor's verdict and a line for Mustafa.

NIGHT_SHIFT.md 'only status comments by the Mergincanli account count': not asked for. Justified, because it closes a known STATUS risk on a public issue. Every session also posts as Mergincanli, so it only shuts out outsiders. The PR should say so.
Night shift 'start or resume no item from 07:45': stricter than the brief's 'start no new item after 07:45'. Small, but it changes the brief's rule. Match the brief or list it as a deviation.
Hard-constraints heading relabel '(the legacy game)' and retiring ADR-001..003: not asked for, and not allowed without an ADR or Mustafa (see contradictions). Drop it.
docs/REPO_MAP.md check script: an extra, justified by 2c's 'current' map, but its location and when it runs are not stated.
docs/research/README.md, the protocol step 4 'research' evidence line, and the CLAUDE.md 'Never' additions: not literally in §2, but they put brief §4 and 2c into the rules. Justified.
.claude/claude-security-guidance.md context line (Rust server over WebTransport): small and justified by 'update for the new stack'.

Explicitly passing model 'opus' to the built-in agents (Explore, Plan, general-purpose), and pinning 'claude-opus-5-5' instead of the alias: justified by 2a. Pinning means a policy edit when a newer Opus arrives; the plan notes this.
The Unit Forge runbook as the source for CHECKPOINTS.md: brief §2b allowed it, but the user has now said not to spend effort on Unit Forge. Treat it as not justified any more.

I traced 47 atomic requirements (from brief §1, §2a-2e, §3 where it binds the night-shift file, the §4 method, and §5-§7) against plan items 1-13 in /home/user/Shamble-Frontlines/.checkpoints/kit-v3-0/plan.md. Coverage: 28 full, 18 partial, 1 missing.

Missing: §1 'Every engine feature exists because VISION_V2 §6 needs it'. It is not written into CLAUDE.md, engine-architect or the advisor.

Most serious problems:
1. The plan has the session merge on an advance go. That contradicts both brief §2 ('Mustafa merges it himself') and CLAUDE.md/advisor.md (the go must come after the APPROVE of the current head).
2. Plan item 2 adapts Unit Forge's runbook. The user has now said Unit Forge is a separate, unfinished tool and the work belongs on Shamble Frontlines. Build checkpoints from the brief's five rules alone.
3. NIGHT_SHIFT rule 4's 'restart cleanly' is not explicitly removed, against 2b rule 4.
4. CLAUDE.md's 'reviewers are read-only' line is not amended, even though five reviewers and six new agents get Write.
5. Relabelling the hard constraints '(the legacy game)' is a constraint change without an ADR.

Smaller gaps:
- The advisor and docs-keeper have no way to write checkpoint notes.
- The 'agents build in isolated copies' exception is missing.
- The source-preference order, the ADR spike section (the ADR template lacks one), the six ADR subjects and the explicit 'then stop' are missing.
- The per-step done/checkpointed/next summary (§6) is not committed to.
- The '07:45 no resume' wording goes beyond the brief.

Extras the brief did not ask for: checkpoint.mjs with watch/[skip ci], the web tools in settings.json, the Mergincanli-only status rule, and the brief copy in docs/. They are mostly justified but need security review and explicit deviation notes.
